infobox.usage: Unlocks the trunk of the Merin car on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Merin car trunk key (Merin) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to a trunk of the Merin sports coupe car.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The Merin car is located on a small parking lot in the west of Lighthouse.
